text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! Trying to place an edict on this academy's nightingale, I see.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I swear, you too are simply making a mountain out of a molehill. Pain, no matter the type, is trivial for the Overlord.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes… Be it a gash from a frigid blade of ice or a searing wound from a raging fire!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed! But I will not kneel. My determination shall be known! In fact, I could convey it through operatic expression this very moment!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That's it! We will dance! Now is the time to compose a new ballad!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My courage in the face of hardship will lift the spirits of all—my own too, of course.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This pain shall become my strength. Trainer, let us go to the dance studio posthaste!
choice_data_list: …All right, let's give it a go!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This pain shall become my strength. Trainer, let us go to the dance studio posthaste!
choice_data_list: …All right, let's give it a go!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Are you telling me my efforts to encourage will only elicit tears of despair?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sigh… If you say so, I must hold back. After all, the Overlord must only inspire joy.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: While unfortunate, relenting appears to be best. I shall review past scripts in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A crestfallen T.M. Opera O lies down in bed… and focuses on her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't understand her reasoning, but if she's this motivated, I'll take the chance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This swan spreads her injured wings in search of the heavens. If she cannot take to the skies, then she must dance.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Laaa-di-da-di-daaa! ♪Dooo-di-do-di… Ack?!
choice_data_list: Whoa! Did you twist your ankle?!
Whoa! Did you twist your ankle?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …Hmph.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Strength is a double-edged sword… But that is but another aspect… of beauty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a careless twirl, she twists her ankle and collapses in pain. We take the time necessary for her to recover.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hum-di-duuum ♪ Mm-mm-hmmm ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …Perfect! The strength and grace of a swan taking to the sky is embodied through these movements!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well? Did I appear injured to you during my opera?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Haaah ha ha! Stand back and observe, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: For this moment marks the birth of my magnum opus!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having saw no signs of an injury during her dance, we start training again right after!
